title: WHATWG URL Workstream-relevant MDN issues
description: Issue filed on MDN Web Docs related to pages attached to technologies developed by WHATWG URL Workstream

items.content_html:
MDN URL

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/sort

What specific section or headline is this issue about?

Overview

What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

URLSearchParams sort in MDN states:

The sort order is according to unicode code points of the keys

However, it is instead over UTF-16 code units, per the WHATWG specification: https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-urlsearchparams-sort

This is subtley different, and is what aligns with javascript string less than specified behaviour.

What did you expect to see?

To align with the specified behaviour which is over utf16 code units.
